summary: MetLife, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose the declaration of routine quarterly dividends on its Series A, Series E, and Series F preferred stocks. The filing includes dividend amounts per share and per depositary share, with payment dates and record dates to be set. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change identified. The filing is a standard current report on other events and exhibits, with no special-situation catalysts.
